About

My path started in education — a Bachelor's degree from the University of Dhaka and a stretch of time in front of a classroom. Along the way, I kept returning to a different kind of teaching material: data.

I taught myself Python, SQL and the core tools of data analysis and machine learning, then went further with a structured program in statistics, EDA and predictive modeling. What carried over from teaching is the instinct to slow down, ask what a number is actually saying, and explain it so it's useful to someone else.
